near.q: What is the rule of thirds in photography? Keep your answer short.
near.reply: The rule of thirds is a compositional guideline in photography that suggests dividing the frame into nine equal parts with two horizontal and two vertical lines. Placing points of interest along these lines or at their intersections creates a more balanced and visually interesting image than centering the subject.
